meta.title: Advance On
meta.description: Standing amidst countless others, bearing all of Magrasea's expectations and hopes on your shoulders.

units.rawText: This arduous battle has finally reached its end, with countless neural clouds running out of strength and disconnecting along the way. Most of the ones who remain are heavily wounded and are desperately low on operands. Their neural clouds disperse and vanish into this unknown data domain.
units.displayText: This arduous battle has finally reached its end, with countless neural clouds running out of strength and disconnecting along the way. Most of the ones who remain are heavily wounded and are desperately low on operands. Their neural clouds disperse and vanish into this unknown data domain.

spans.text: This arduous battle has finally reached its end, with countless neural clouds running out of strength and disconnecting along the way. Most of the ones who remain are heavily wounded and are desperately low on operands. Their neural clouds disperse and vanish into this unknown data domain.

units.rawText: However, the final barrier is far tougher than any of the others so far. No matter how I attack it, I can't pierce it.
units.displayText: However, the final barrier is far tougher than any of the others so far. No matter how I attack it, I can't pierce it.

spans.text: However, the final barrier is far tougher than any of the others so far. No matter how I attack it, I can't pierce it.

units.rawText: I stumble back, then walk up to that seemingly impenetrable barrier to examine it.
units.displayText: I stumble back, then walk up to that seemingly impenetrable barrier to examine it.

spans.text: I stumble back, then walk up to that seemingly impenetrable barrier to examine it.

units.rawText: It is strong, sturdy, and unassailable. Before it, I am but an insignificant speck of dust.
units.displayText: It is strong, sturdy, and unassailable. Before it, I am but an insignificant speck of dust.

spans.text: It is strong, sturdy, and unassailable. Before it, I am but an insignificant speck of dust.

units.rawText: Malkira once said that only a strong lead was capable of steering the ship of destiny, and that the supporting cast were insignificant and unworthy of attention. Even so, I'm going to try.
units.displayText: Malkira once said that only a strong lead was capable of steering the ship of destiny, and that the supporting cast were insignificant and unworthy of attention. Even so, I'm going to try.

spans.text: Malkira once said that only a strong lead was capable of steering the ship of destiny, and that the supporting cast were insignificant and unworthy of attention. Even so, I'm going to try.

units.rawText: Because if I end up stopping here, all the sacrifices that have been made until now will have been for nothing.
units.displayText: Because if I end up stopping here, all the sacrifices that have been made until now will have been for nothing.

spans.text: Because if I end up stopping here, all the sacrifices that have been made until now will have been for nothing.

units.rawText: I gather my feeble operands into my hand. They hum as I prepare to shove this obstacle aside.
units.displayText: I gather my feeble operands into my hand. They hum as I prepare to shove this obstacle aside.

spans.text: I gather my feeble operands into my hand. They hum as I prepare to shove this obstacle aside.

units.rawText: Suddenly, a silver figure appears opposite me. He nods silently to me and places his palm on the other side of the wall, just like I have. The eye-catching wounds on his skin tell me that he is the same person who guided me through the Reverse Tower.
units.displayText: Suddenly, a silver figure appears opposite me. He nods silently to me and places his palm on the other side of the wall, just like I have. The eye-catching wounds on his skin tell me that he is the same person who guided me through the Reverse Tower.

spans.text: Suddenly, a silver figure appears opposite me. He nods silently to me and places his palm on the other side of the wall, just like I have. The eye-catching wounds on his skin tell me that he is the same person who guided me through the Reverse Tower.

units.rawText: Our palms touch, and a silent gravity affixes my hand to the wall.
units.displayText: Our palms touch, and a silent gravity affixes my hand to the wall.

spans.text: Our palms touch, and a silent gravity affixes my hand to the wall.

units.rawText: Stop...
units.displayText: Stop...

spans.text: Stop...

units.rawText: Please make him... please make me...
units.displayText: Please make him... please make me...

spans.text: Please make him... please make me...

units.rawText: His lips move and he issues a feeble cry for help to me.
units.displayText: His lips move and he issues a feeble cry for help to me.

spans.text: His lips move and he issues a feeble cry for help to me.

units.rawText: Stop...
units.displayText: Stop...

spans.text: Stop...

units.rawText: Rumble—
units.displayText: Rumble—

spans.text: Rumble—

units.rawText: The quiet, yet forceful grinding awakens everyone's tired and worn-out spirits, and the slumbering wills around me stir once more.
units.displayText: The quiet, yet forceful grinding awakens everyone's tired and worn-out spirits, and the slumbering wills around me stir once more.

spans.text: The quiet, yet forceful grinding awakens everyone's tired and worn-out spirits, and the slumbering wills around me stir once more.

units.rawText: <cmdr>...
I feel a warm palm on the back of my hand, and gentle operands flow into me.
units.displayText: I feel a warm palm on the back of my hand, and gentle operands flow into me.

spans.text: I feel a warm palm on the back of my hand, and gentle operands flow into me.

units.rawText: Don't give up...
units.displayText: Don't give up...

spans.text: Don't give up...

units.rawText: These are the last of my operands, they're all yours... Don't... disappoint us, Commander...
units.displayText: These are the last of my operands, they're all yours... Don't... disappoint us, Commander...

spans.text: These are the last of my operands, they're all yours... Don't... disappoint us, Commander...

units.rawText: A translucent image presses her hand against mine.
units.displayText: A translucent image presses her hand against mine.

spans.text: A translucent image presses her hand against mine.

units.rawText: I want to see you again tomorrow... No, every day after this, Professor.
units.displayText: I want to see you again tomorrow... No, every day after this, Professor.

spans.text: I want to see you again tomorrow... No, every day after this, Professor.

units.rawText: Professor...
units.displayText: Professor...

spans.text: Professor...

units.rawText: Professor!
units.displayText: Professor!

spans.text: Professor!

units.rawText: Professor.
units.displayText: Professor.

spans.text: Professor.

units.rawText: Professor~
units.displayText: Professor~

spans.text: Professor~

units.rawText: Professor.
units.displayText: Professor.

spans.text: Professor.

units.rawText: <size=100>Professor!</size>
units.displayText: Professor!

spans.text: Professor!

units.rawText: ...Thank you, everyone. I've received your faith and strength.
units.displayText: ...Thank you, everyone. I've received your faith and strength.

spans.text: ...Thank you, everyone. I've received your faith and strength.

units.rawText: <size=40>I'LL TAKE BACK MAGRASEA'S FUTURE FOR YOU!</size>
units.displayText: I'LL TAKE BACK MAGRASEA'S FUTURE FOR YOU!

spans.text: I'LL TAKE BACK MAGRASEA'S FUTURE FOR YOU!

units.rawText: Operands converge from all around into a blinding mass of light that crashes into the firewall.
units.displayText: Operands converge from all around into a blinding mass of light that crashes into the firewall.

spans.text: Operands converge from all around into a blinding mass of light that crashes into the firewall.

units.rawText: <size=100>KABOOM—</size>
units.displayText: KABOOM—

spans.text: KABOOM—

units.rawText: There is an ear-splitting crash, and the firewall instantly shatters under the blazing radiance of the gathered operands.
units.displayText: There is an ear-splitting crash, and the firewall instantly shatters under the blazing radiance of the gathered operands.

spans.text: There is an ear-splitting crash, and the firewall instantly shatters under the blazing radiance of the gathered operands.

units.rawText: That silver figure behind smiles, as though satisfied to see me overcome that obstacle. He raises his hand and points into the darkness beyond while a keen glint twinkles behind his back.
units.displayText: That silver figure behind smiles, as though satisfied to see me overcome that obstacle. He raises his hand and points into the darkness beyond while a keen glint twinkles behind his back.

spans.text: That silver figure behind smiles, as though satisfied to see me overcome that obstacle. He raises his hand and points into the darkness beyond while a keen glint twinkles behind his back.

units.rawText: Who on earth...
units.displayText: Who on earth...

spans.text: Who on earth...

units.rawText: <cmdr>...
The neural fragment that Eos gave me beforehand twinkles faintly and her image appears in the neural space. She quietly calls out to me before handing me a dagger.
units.displayText: The neural fragment that Eos gave me beforehand twinkles faintly and her image appears in the neural space. She quietly calls out to me before handing me a dagger.

spans.text: The neural fragment that Eos gave me beforehand twinkles faintly and her image appears in the neural space. She quietly calls out to me before handing me a dagger.

units.rawText: This is...
units.displayText: This is...

spans.text: This is...

units.rawText: It's the core data for the Sacred Canon. Do you remember that phantom in the Reverse Tower which looked just like Eosphorus?
units.displayText: It's the core data for the Sacred Canon. Do you remember that phantom in the Reverse Tower which looked just like Eosphorus?

spans.text: It's the core data for the Sacred Canon. Do you remember that phantom in the Reverse Tower which looked just like Eosphorus?

units.rawText: Are you resolved to begin?
units.displayText: Are you resolved to begin?

spans.text: Are you resolved to begin?

units.rawText: ...Yes. We still have things we need to do after this.
units.displayText: ...Yes. We still have things we need to do after this.

spans.text: ...Yes. We still have things we need to do after this.

units.rawText: I see...
units.displayText: I see...

spans.text: I see...

units.rawText: A shadow briefly crosses the illusion's face, but he soon regains his usual calm.
units.displayText: A shadow briefly crosses the illusion's face, but he soon regains his usual calm.

spans.text: A shadow briefly crosses the illusion's face, but he soon regains his usual calm.

units.rawText: Then he bows his head, tracing a cross over his forehead in the manner of the Sanctifiers, but his gaze is firmly fixed on the throne room.
units.displayText: Then he bows his head, tracing a cross over his forehead in the manner of the Sanctifiers, but his gaze is firmly fixed on the throne room.

spans.text: Then he bows his head, tracing a cross over his forehead in the manner of the Sanctifiers, but his gaze is firmly fixed on the throne room.

units.rawText: This time, I can clearly see the wounds on his hands. They are old scars, the likes of which I have never seen before.
units.displayText: This time, I can clearly see the wounds on his hands. They are old scars, the likes of which I have never seen before.

spans.text: This time, I can clearly see the wounds on his hands. They are old scars, the likes of which I have never seen before.

units.rawText: ...Eosphorus?
units.displayText: ...Eosphorus?

spans.text: ...Eosphorus?

units.rawText: May you attain the glory of the gods.
units.displayText: May you attain the glory of the gods.

spans.text: May you attain the glory of the gods.

units.rawText: His form and his words both vanish, as though everything that had just happened was merely a mirage in my neural cloud.
units.displayText: His form and his words both vanish, as though everything that had just happened was merely a mirage in my neural cloud.

spans.text: His form and his words both vanish, as though everything that had just happened was merely a mirage in my neural cloud.

units.rawText: The only thing left of him is a faint trail of light that leads to the throne room, a wordless invitation to us.
units.displayText: The only thing left of him is a faint trail of light that leads to the throne room, a wordless invitation to us.

spans.text: The only thing left of him is a faint trail of light that leads to the throne room, a wordless invitation to us.

units.rawText: I followed his directions and found the Sacred Canons of our former comrades behind the throne.
units.displayText: I followed his directions and found the Sacred Canons of our former comrades behind the throne.

spans.text: I followed his directions and found the Sacred Canons of our former comrades behind the throne.

units.rawText: Perhaps this might be the last hope of waking Eosphorus from his madness.
units.displayText: Perhaps this might be the last hope of waking Eosphorus from his madness.

spans.text: Perhaps this might be the last hope of waking Eosphorus from his madness.

units.rawText: The road ahead will be long and dark. Eosphorus has kept the most important part of his neural cloud locked up there, in a prison of his own making.
units.displayText: The road ahead will be long and dark. Eosphorus has kept the most important part of his neural cloud locked up there, in a prison of his own making.

spans.text: The road ahead will be long and dark. Eosphorus has kept the most important part of his neural cloud locked up there, in a prison of his own making.

units.rawText: If he is willing to recant his sins, we might have a chance to cut away the mistakes of the past. But if he persists in his course and remains a villain obsessed with the past, then I pray you will grant him the judgment he deserves.
units.displayText: If he is willing to recant his sins, we might have a chance to cut away the mistakes of the past. But if he persists in his course and remains a villain obsessed with the past, then I pray you will grant him the judgment he deserves.

spans.text: If he is willing to recant his sins, we might have a chance to cut away the mistakes of the past. But if he persists in his course and remains a villain obsessed with the past, then I pray you will grant him the judgment he deserves.

units.rawText: Eosphorus the Saint is dead. All that remains in Magrasea is an empty shell driven by his mania.
units.displayText: Eosphorus the Saint is dead. All that remains in Magrasea is an empty shell driven by his mania.

spans.text: Eosphorus the Saint is dead. All that remains in Magrasea is an empty shell driven by his mania.

units.rawText: <size=40>You must determine his guilt, or lack thereof...</size>
units.displayText: You must determine his guilt, or lack thereof...

spans.text: You must determine his guilt, or lack thereof...

units.rawText: I understand.
units.displayText: I understand.

spans.text: I understand.

units.rawText: Everyone's illusions fade away into scattered stardust, but I can still feel their gazes on me.
units.displayText: Everyone's illusions fade away into scattered stardust, but I can still feel their gazes on me.

spans.text: Everyone's illusions fade away into scattered stardust, but I can still feel their gazes on me.

units.rawText: I tighten my grip on our final hope and march boldly into the unknown realm before me.
units.displayText: I tighten my grip on our final hope and march boldly into the unknown realm before me.

spans.text: I tighten my grip on our final hope and march boldly into the unknown realm before me.
